# Documentation site

This site is built with Docusaurus into static pages, with an offline search index and diagrams drawn from text, so it works on a site with no internet. A small file server serves it on the documentation host.

Back to the [component catalogue](./index.md).

| Component | Kind | Scope | Fit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| npm:@docusaurus/core | npm package | build | Pass |
| npm:@docusaurus/plugin-content-docs | npm package | build | Pass |

## npm:@docusaurus/core

**What it provides.** Builds the static documentation site.

**Why it is needed.** Builds this documentation site into static pages that need no code running on a server. Without it we would need another site generator.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | npm package |
| Pinned version or digest | `3.10.2` |
| Architecture component | `release-pipeline` |
| Used in | `docs-site/package.json` |
| Scope | Build only: not shipped |
| Licence | MIT |
| Cryptography | None |
| Air gap | Works with no internet access |
| Compliance fit | Pass |
| Controls | SA-15, SR-3 |
| Security fixes | Blocking: the CI docs job runs npm audit --audit-level=high over the docs-site lockfile (dev dependencies included); also recorded daily. Bumped by hand in a reviewed PR. |
| Reviewed | Claude (agent review; owner to confirm), 2026-11-23 |

## npm:@docusaurus/plugin-content-docs

**What it provides.** Docs content plugin for the documentation site.

**Why it is needed.** Turns the Markdown pages under docs-site/content, and the repository documents copied in at build time, into the site's pages and menu. Docusaurus cannot render documentation pages without it.

## npm:@docusaurus/theme-mermaid

**What it provides.** Renders Mermaid diagrams in the documentation site, in the browser, without a remote service.

**Why it is needed.** Draws the diagrams in these pages, such as the architecture diagrams, from text, in the browser. Without it diagrams would be images kept up to date by hand, or drawn by a remote service that an air-gapped site cannot reach.

## npm:@easyops-cn/docusaurus-search-local

**What it provides.** Offline search index for the documentation site (no hosted search service).

**Why it is needed.** Builds the search index with the site, so search works offline and sends nothing anywhere. A hosted search service would not work at an air-gapped site.
